notes.title: Major Update - Public Alpha (v2.1.3-22)
notes.content:
[b]This is a public alpha release - which means that it's important to back up your work as you could find bugs which our testers haven't encountered previously.[/b]

For full release notes for the Public Alpha (version 2.1.3-22) please see: [url]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1d7SGoRu90GXKt6yapuqRpqm19TH3Crk6yWAduZCmUZg[/url]

[h2]Public Alpha Features:[/h2]
[list][*] Auto Backups
[*] Error scanning and rounding error fixes
[*] Split and join rails
[*] Group move
[*] Camera changes
[*] Paste with BPM
[*] Object highlighting
[/list]

[h2]Public Alpha Opt-In[/h2]
To opt-in to the Public Alpha and access these new features:
[list][*] Right click on the Synth Riders Beatmap Editor in Steam
[*] Choose "Properties", then "Betas"
[*] Opt-in by selecting "public.alpha.a2" on the Beta Participation drop down list
[/list]

[h2]Reporting Issues:[/h2]
[list][*] If you encounter issues which are not on the [url=https://synthridersvr.com/editor-bugs/]Beatmap Editor Bug List[/url], have feedback or wish to make a feature request, the fastest way to let us know is to join us in the [url=https://discord.synthridersvr.com]Synth Riders Official Discord[/url].  There you can make #editor-bug-reports or request features in the #editor-wishlist.
[*] When reporting issues, please let us know what you were doing at the time, whether you are able to reproduce it and if so, how. Video of it happening is helpful in narrowing down the cause.[/list]
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Major Update - Public Beta (v2.1.0-4 beta)
notes.content:
This is a public beta release - which means that it's [b]important to back up your work[/b] as you could find bugs which our testers haven't encountered previously. But at this stage, we would like as many of you as possible to get onto the editor and [url=http://discord.synthridersvr.com/]give us more feedback[/url]!

[b]To opt into the Public Beta branch:[/b]
[list][*]Open Steam and right click on the Beatmap Editor 
[*] Choose Properties 
[*] Choose Betas 
[*] Opt in to the "public.beta"[/list]

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
A summary of new features and changes is below.  For more detailed information on features, please see the [b][url=https://synthridersvr.com/editor-guide]Beatmap Editor Reference Guide[/url][/b] which is updated to incorporate all changes between the current Production Editor (v 1.9.7-10) and the Public Beta

[h3]For this build, you will need to [b]reset your editor keybinds to default[/b]. This will clear any existing faulty/duplicate bindings (even if you don't use them) and migrate you to the new default keybinds.[/h3]

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list][*][b]Gridless rail move:[/b] when snap to grid is off, rail heads and nodes can be dragged off-grid.
[*][b]Move Rail Head:[/b] you can now move a rail head without moving the entire rail with it (ctrl + left-click drag). You can still move an entire rail at once with alt drag.
[*][b]Note Outline Toggle:[/b] toggle note outlines on or off (ctrl+q).
[*][b]Free Camera Improvements:[/b] free camera now moves more responsively (hold right-click and use WASD + Q/E while in free camera mode). 9 now resets the free camera position.
[*][b]Measure Indicator:[/b] shows what bar or beat your editor plane is on.[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes/Changes:[/h2]
[list][*][b]Playback desync fix[/b] - the way timing is done has been changed to sort out playback desync.
[*][b]Ghost notes fix[/b] - deleted notes should no longer give audio cues.
[*][b]Save changes[/b] - changes to the save function were made to resolve save issues (however anti-virus, permissions or having a file open outside of the editor may still interfere).
[*]Intermittent cursor loss addressed.
[*]Very dense stacks of notes should no longer cause audio loss on playback.
[*]Holding onto a rail head while scrolling should no longer cause the editor to crash.
[*]Terminology around rails has changed to be more consistent.
[*]Obstacle confirmation messages changed to be more clear.
[*]Default keybindings have been changed to avoid conflicting functions and consistency with existing hotkeys:
[code]Ctrl/8 = Toggle Triangle 
Ctrl/B = Toggle Bookmark 
9      = Reset Free Camera View 
Q/E    = Camera Down, Camera Up (hold right-click)
WASD   = Forward/Horizontal Movement (hold right-click)[/code][/list]

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[list][*][b]Geforce Experience may interfere with the rail snapping toggle shortcut (Alt+F3)[/b]**. To solve this you can either disable Geforce overlay, go into Geforce In-Game Overlay Settings and change the hotkey binding to something else or rebind the hotkey in the editor.
[*]For all other known issues / bugs, please see the [b][url=https://synthridersvr.com/editor-bugs/]Beatmap Editor Bug List[/url][/b] (Google Sheet)[/list]

[h2]Reporting Issues:[/h2]
[list][*] If you encounter issues which are not on the [url=https://synthridersvr.com/editor-bugs/]Beatmap Editor Bug List[/url], have feedback or wish to make a feature request, the fastest way to let us know is to join us in the [url=https://discord.synthridersvr.com]Synth Riders Official Discord[/url].  There you can make #editor-bug-reports or request features in the #editor-wishlist.
[*] When reporting issues, please let us know what you were doing at the time, whether you are able to reproduce it and if so, how. Video of it happening is helpful in narrowing down the cause.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Thank You:[/h2]
This update has been long overdue, so a big thank you to our Developers, OST Team and volunteer Editor Beta Testers who have helped us in getting this major update out to public beta: whattheshark, DuckCurious, LittleAsi, Teebo, Fasty, Ichderhorst, Oneill, VarenyeKuritsa, Artanis, EggFriedCheese, Emikodo, Excession, Hawkwolf, Melon4Dinner, TheZhad, WitchyRe, Wonderful

notes.title: Minor Update: Public Beta 2.0.0-6
notes.content:
Release 2.0.0-6 of the [b]Public Beta[/b] version of the editor includes performance fix for note outlines.

Opting into the public beta is easy:
[list]
[*] Right click on the editor in Steam
[*] Select "BETAS"
[*] Choose "public-beta" from the drop down list (no code required)
[/list]

Your install will update and you will find you have access to the extra obstacle shapes etc.

[b]As always, please remember to backup your maps when using the public-beta version!
[/b]

We would love your feedback - bugs, issues, feature requests - on the Synth Riders Discord at ([url=http://discord.synthridersvr.com/]discord.synthridersvr.com[/url]) in the #editor channels!

notes.title: Update 1.9.4
notes.content:
Hi Synth Mappers! We have been working hard on our editor and have quite a few updates for you that should make it more easier to create and edit your Synth Riders maps:

[list]
[*] Mirror Function: CTRL + ALT + LMB now allows you to mirror the selected note
[*] Object Scrolling: TAB now allows you to select the type of object that you want to use to navigate the timeline
[*] Enhanced Copy Paste: this is now supported in multiple ways; CTRL+V pastes the content normally while ALT+V pastes the content and inverts the colors/positions of the objects
[*] Enhanced Bookmarks: There is now a scrollbar to navigate the timeline and more easily find your bookmarks
[*] Note Type Changes: SHIFT + LMB you can change the color (type) of the note selected
[*] Last Note Shadow: By pressing on Q you can toggle the visualization of the last note placed
[*] Live Placing Notes: By pressing on N you can now place a note placeholder while the song is being reproduced
[*] Keyboard Only Edition: You can place and select notes using your keyboard (WASD or the arrows) while you are pressing the N key
[*] Enhance Stats Windows: By pressing the F12 key you can see song stats and the level of difficulty in which you are working on
[*] Snap Editing Plane to Note and Snap Note to Editing Plane: ALT + RMB takes you to the note editor plane of the note you selected and by pressing on ALT + LMB you can take the selected note to the editor plane
[*] Placed Notes Edition: ALT + LMB allows you to move the position of the notes, also allowing you to move nodes of long note lines (or ‘rails’) to change the way in which the line is built
[*] Flip Notes: By pressing on F you can invert the position of the selected Notes
[*] Remote Note Delete: CTRL + RMB allows you to remotely delete notes
[/list]

Important warning: once you open a track with the latest editor 1.9 version, you cannot open the track with previous versions of the editor. The game itself currently supports tracks made with both, the new 1.9 version and version 1.8.

Happy mapping!

As always we welcome your feedback and bug reports on our [url=http://discord.synthridersvr.com]Official discord server[/url]. Please use #bugs-report to make sure that we see your feedback.
